ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Личность» (lichnost', 'personality') is kept as the term for what conceals God in a person, with Tolstoy's generic 'he'; «свойственно» (svoystvenno, 'proper to') is kept literal in the day's thought and in reading 4. In the closing thought «не останется бесплодно» (ne ostanetsya besplodno, 'will not remain fruitless') is kept as a negation, where the website draft had 'bears fruit'; the Sirach attribution is printed «Иисус, сын Сирахов» (Iisus, syn Sirakhov) and rendered 'Jesus, son of Sirach'.
